name: New Mexico Fabrics and Foam
old_description: Let R&R Trim Supply Help You Complete Your Upholstery Projects
about:
New Mexico Fabrics and Foam, also operating as R&R Trim Supply, is a family-owned business founded in 1985 by Robert and Ray Sanchez and Caroline Day in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company began as a supplier of upholstery materials, building on the Sanchez family's 52-year history in the upholstery trade.

The company maintains a warehouse open to the public near I-25 and Lomas Boulevard, stocking a broad inventory of decorative fabrics—including Western, Southwestern, and contract velvets—along with foam rubber, vinyl, leather, carpet, headliner material, convertible tops, and a range of fasteners, cleaners, and adhesives. It offers foam cutting to size and fulfills bulk orders for custom bolts and foam.

Customers span automotive, marine, furniture, and commercial upholstery sectors, as well as do-it-yourself enthusiasts. The business serves both high-volume upholstery shops and individual project needs.

The founders established the company on principles of customer service, satisfaction, and quality products, aiming to provide quality service and products for all upholstery and craft needs. Discounts and mill drops are available to help customers finish projects on a budget.
